# ECLIPSE-Compatible Reservoir Engineering (`.data`, `.dat`, `.inc`)

`@modelscript/eclipse` (`languages/eclipse`) provides zero-regex parsing, multiphase Darcy material balance solving, Peaceman well inflow modeling, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **ECLIPSE-compatible 100 (Black Oil) & 300 (Compositional)** reservoir simulation decks.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension       | Format               | Description                                                                                     |
| :-------------- | :------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.data`         | ECLIPSE Master Deck  | Structured keyword deck defining grid geometry, rock/fluid properties, and well schedules       |
| `.dat` / `.inc` | ECLIPSE Include File | Modular sub-decks for PVT tables (`PROPS`), well completions (`SCHEDULE`), or permeability maps |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Sectioned Deck Architecture & Table Records

- Parses all standard ECLIPSE keyword sections:
  - **`RUNSPEC`**: Phases (OIL, WATER, GAS, DISGAS), grid dimensions ($N_x \times N_y \times N_z$), unit systems (FIELD, METRIC, LAB).
  - **`GRID`**: Block dimensions (`DX`, `DY`, `DZ`), top depths (`TOPS`), porosity (`PORO`), and directional permeabilities (`PERMX`, `PERMY`, `PERMZ`).
  - **`PROPS`**: Multi-phase relative permeability curves (`SWOF`, `SGOF`) and PVT tables (`PVDO`, `PVTW`, `PVDG`).
  - **`REGIONS`**: Fluid and equilibrium region partitions.
  - **`SOLUTION`**: Initial equilibrium pressure and saturation distributions (`PRESSURE`, `SWAT`, `SOIL`).
  - **`SCHEDULE`**: Well specifications (`WELSPECS`), completion intervals (`COMPDAT`), production controls (`WCONPROD`), and water/gas injection controls (`WCONINJE`).

### 2. Multiphase Darcy Flow & Material Balance Solver

- Computes original hydrocarbons in place:
  - **Stock Tank Oil Initially In Place (STOIIP)**:
    $$\text{STOIIP} = \sum_{k} \frac{V_{b,k} \cdot \phi_k \cdot S_{o,k}}{B_{oi}}$$
  - **Gas Initially In Place (GIIP)**:
    $$\text{GIIP} = \sum_{k} \frac{V_{b,k} \cdot \phi_k \cdot (S_{g,k} + S_{o,k} R_{si})}{B_{gi}}$$
- Evaluates dynamic reservoir depletion using the generalized **Havlena-Odeh material balance equation**:
  $$N_p \left[ B_o + (R_p - R_s) B_g \right] + W_p B_w = N \left[ (B_o - B_{oi}) + (R_{si} - R_s) B_g \right] + m N B_{oi} \left( \frac{B_g}{B_{gi}} - 1 \right) + (1 + m) N B_{oi} \frac{c_w S_{wi} + c_f}{1 - S_{wi}} \Delta P + W_{\text{inj}} B_w$$
- Evaluates well deliverability via the **Peaceman well model**:
  $$q_p = PI \cdot (P_{\text{block}} - P_{\text{bh}}), \quad PI = \frac{2 \pi k h}{\mu B \left( \ln \frac{r_o}{r_w} + s \right)}$$
  where $r_o = 0.28 \frac{\sqrt{(k_y / k_x)^{1/2} \Delta x^2 + (k_x / k_y)^{1/2} \Delta y^2}}{(k_y / k_x)^{1/4} + (k_x / k_y)^{1/4}}$ is Peaceman's equivalent block radius.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Lowers reservoir grid pore volumes, multi-phase flow equations, and well drawdown constraints into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation between subterranean porous media flow and surface transient multiphase gathering pipelines ([`@modelscript/olga`](./olga.md)) and process facilities ([`@modelscript/aspen`](./aspen.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects reservoir blocks and production wells into `Modelica.Fluid` porous media volumes and source boundaries.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The ECLIPSE validator inspects grid bounds, PVT table monotonicity, and well completions:

### Diagnostics for ECLIPSE (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8701` | error | `missing-reservoir-phases` | RUNSPEC section does not specify any active fluid phases ('OIL', 'WATER', or 'GAS'). |
| `M8702` | error | `invalid-grid-dimensions` | Reservoir grid dimensions must be strictly positive integers (got <nx> x <ny> x <nz>). |
| `M8703` | error | `porosity-out-of-range` | Reservoir porosity (<val>) must be strictly positive and less than 1.0. |
| `M8704` | error | `negative-permeability` | Reservoir permeability '<prop>' (<val> mD) must be strictly positive. |
| `M8705` | error | `non-monotonic-pvt-table` | PVT table '<table>' has non-monotonic pressure progression (<prevP> -> <curP>). |
| `M8706` | error | `dangling-well-completion` | Well completion for '<wellName>' at (<i>,<j>,<k>) exceeds grid boundary (<nx>,<ny>,<nz>). |
| `M8707` | error | `non-monotonic-saturation-table` | Relative permeability table '<table>' has non-monotonic saturation progression (<prevSat> -> <curSat>). |
| `M8708` | error | `undefined-well-reference` | Keyword '<contextKeyword>' references well '<wellName>' not defined in WELSPECS. |
| `M8709` | error | `invalid-well-control-target` | Well '<wellName>' specifies invalid control target for '<mode>' (<val>). |
| `M8710` | error | `negative-formation-volume-factor` | PVT property specifies non-positive formation volume factor B_<phase> (<fvf>). |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect grid dimensions, fluid phases, and well completions

# Run pre-flight linting and PVT table monotonicity checks

```

# RELAP5-3D-Compatible Nuclear Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics (`.i`, `.inp`, `.r5`)

`@modelscript/relap5` (`languages/relap5`) provides high-fidelity 80-column card deck parsing, non-equilibrium two-phase hydrodynamic modeling, 6-group delayed neutron point kinetics solving, DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **RELAP5-3D-compatible** nuclear reactor systems, thermal-hydraulic loops, and safety margin evaluations.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension     | Format                 | Description                                                                                             |
| :------------ | :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.i` / `.inp` | RELAP5 Input Card Deck | Fixed-column card deck specifying hydrodynamic volumes, junctions, heat structures, trips, and kinetics |
| `.r5`         | RELAP5-3D System Deck  | Multi-loop PWR/BWR coolant systems, steam generators, emergency core cooling systems (ECCS)             |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Two-Phase Non-Equilibrium Hydrodynamics

- Employs a full **6-equation two-fluid formulation** with separate mass, momentum, and energy conservation equations for liquid and vapor phases:
  - **Phase Mass Conservation**:
    $$\frac{\partial}{\partial t} (\alpha_k \rho_k) + \frac{1}{A} \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\alpha_k \rho_k v_k A) = \Gamma_k \quad (k \in \{l, v\})$$
  - **Phase Momentum Conservation**:
    $$\alpha_k \rho_k \frac{\partial v_k}{\partial t} + \alpha_k \rho_k v_k \frac{\partial v_k}{\partial x} = -\alpha_k \frac{\partial P}{\partial x} + \alpha_k \rho_k g \cos \theta - F_{\text{wall},k} - F_{\text{inter},k} + \Gamma_k (v_{ki} - v_k)$$
  - **Phase Energy Conservation**:
    $$\frac{\partial}{\partial t} (\alpha_k \rho_k u_k) + \frac{1}{A} \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\alpha_k \rho_k u_k v_k A) = -P \left[ \frac{\partial \alpha_k}{\partial t} + \frac{1}{A} \frac{\partial}{\partial x} (\alpha_k v_k A) \right] + Q_{\text{wall},k} + Q_{\text{inter},k} + \Gamma_k h_{ki}$$
- Tracks interphase friction, bubbly/slug/annular flow regime transitions, and subcooled boiling.

### 2. 6-Group Delayed Neutron Point Kinetics & Reactivity Feedback

- Solves the stiff differential equations of reactor core power during transients and reactor SCRAM:
  $$\frac{dP}{dt} = \frac{\rho(t) - \beta}{\Lambda} P(t) + \sum_{i=1}^{6} \lambda_i C_i(t)$$
  $$\frac{dC_i}{dt} = \frac{\beta_i}{\Lambda} P(t) - \lambda_i C_i(t) \quad (i = 1, \dots, 6)$$
  where $P$ is normalized thermal power, $\Lambda$ is prompt neutron generation time, and $\beta = \sum \beta_i$ is delayed neutron fraction.
- Incorporates dynamic physical reactivity feedback:
  $$\rho(t) = \rho_{\text{control}}(t) + \alpha_{\text{Doppler}} \left( \sqrt{T_{\text{fuel}}} - \sqrt{T_{\text{fuel},0}} \right) + \alpha_{\text{density}} (\rho_{\text{mod}} - \rho_{\text{mod},0})$$
  ensuring negative Doppler fuel temperature feedback stabilizes reactor transients.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Compiles hydrodynamic volumes, inter-volume junctions, and heat structures into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation between nuclear primary coolant loops, secondary steam turbine power plants, and electrical generator controls ([`@modelscript/psse`](./psse.md)).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects RELAP5 primary loops and core volumes into `Modelica.Fluid` two-phase thermal hydraulic circuits and nuclear reactor models.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The RELAP5 parser and validator enforce card syntax, hydrodynamic connectivity, and trip cutset safety:

### Diagnostics for RELAP5-3D (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8601` | error | `dangling-volume-connection` | Junction '<junctionId>' specifies undefined <end>-volume '<volId>'. |
| `M8602` | error | `unclosed-trip-logic-cutset` | Trip logic '<parentTripId>' references undefined child trip ID '<childTripId>'. |
| `M8603` | error | `negative-heat-capacity` | Heat structure '<hsId>' specifies non-positive conductivity (<k> W/m-K) or capacity (<cp> J/m³-K). |
| `M8604` | warning | `sonic-choked-flow-singularity` | Junction '<junctionId>' flagged for critical sonic choked flow transition. |
| `M8605` | error | `missing-kinetics-delayed-groups` | Point kinetics model specifies <count> delayed groups; standard reactor kinetics requires 6 precursor groups. |
| `M8606` | error | `negative-prompt-neutron-lifetime` | Prompt neutron generation time '<lambda>' s must be strictly positive. |
| `M8607` | warning | `adverse-volume-elevation` | Volume '<volId>' elevation change dz (<dz> m) exceeds physical volume length (<length> m). |
| `M8608` | error | `negative-junction-loss-coefficient` | Junction '<junctionId>' specifies negative form loss coefficient (K_forw=<kForw>, K_rev=<kRev>). |
| `M8609` | error | `invalid-time-step-bounds` | Minimum time step (<minDt> s) exceeds maximum time step (<maxDt> s). |
| `M8610` | error | `negative-pressure-state` | Volume '<volId>' specifies non-positive thermodynamic pressure (<p> Pa). |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect hydrodynamic volumes, junctions, and core kinetics cards

```

# SIMO / RIFLEX-Compatible Marine Operations (`.inp`, `.sima`, `.sys`, `.hyd`)

The `@modelscript/sima` package (`languages/sima`) provides native ingestion, analysis, verification, DAE simulation, and multi-domain projections for **SIMO- and RIFLEX-compatible** offshore marine engineering models and modern **SIMA** project archives.

---

## Supported File Specifications

| Extension           | Format                          | Key Structural Features                                                                                                               |
| :------------------ | :------------------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **`.inp` / `.sys`** | SIMO & RIFLEX Card Decks        | Classical keyword cards: `SYS`, `BODY`, `MASS`, `FAIRLEAD`, `LINE`, `SEGM`, `CRS`, `WAVE`, `WIND`, `CURR`, `DYNMOD`                   |
| **`.sima`**         | Modern SIMA XML Archive         | Hierarchical task manifests (`<simo:SimoTask>`, `<riflex:RiflexTask>`, `<sima:SlenderSystem>`, `<sima:Vessel>`, `<sima:MooringLine>`) |
| **`.hyd` / `.out`** | Hydrodynamic Transfer Functions | 1st-order Force RAO tables, frequency-dependent added mass $A(\omega)$, potential damping $B(\omega)$, and restoring matrices         |

---

## Architecture & Compilation Pipeline

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SRC["SIMO/RIFLEX Decks (.inp, .sys, .hyd) / SIMA XML (.sima)"]

    subgraph FrontEnd["Parser & Static Analysis"]
        PARSER["Card Deck & XML Parsers (parseCardDeck, parseSimaXml)"]
        HYD["Hydrodynamic RAO Ingestion (parseHydFile)"]
        INDEX["SimaWorkspaceIndex (IWorkspaceIndex)"]
        LINT["Pre-Flight Marine Linter (M7001–M7015)"]
    end

    subgraph Core["Analytical, Numerical & In-WASM DAE Solvers"]
        CATENARY["High-Performance Catenary Shooting Solver (solveCatenary)"]
        DNV["DNV-OS-E301 / DNV-ST-0119 Regulatory Verifier"]
        OFFSET["Watch Circle & Excursion Envelope Verifier (evaluateOffsetLimits)"]
        FATIGUE["ASTM E1049 Rainflow & S-N Fatigue Engine (computeFatigueDamage)"]
        CUMMINS["Cummins 6-DOF State-Space Solver (simulateCumminsDynamics)"]
        DAE["DAEBuilder Lowering in Linear Memory (lowerSimaToDae)"]
    end

    subgraph Projections["Multi-Domain Projections"]
        MO["Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody (simaToModelica)"]
        SSP["FMI Co-Simulation SystemStructure.ssd (simaToSsp)"]
        SYSML["Formal SysML v2 Architecture & Constraints (simaToSysml2)"]
    end

    subgraph Presentation["User Experience & Toolchain"]
        CLI["CLI Toolchain (msx sima lint | verify | offset | to-modelica | to-ssp | to-sysml2)"]
        DIAG["Vector Diagram Builder (Catenary Profile & Polar Spread SVG)"]
        IDE["VS Code / Studio Custom Editor (SimaEditorProvider)"]
        LSP["Language Server Protocol Services"]
    end

    SRC --> PARSER
    SRC --> HYD
    PARSER --> INDEX --> LINT
    PARSER --> CATENARY --> DNV
    CATENARY --> OFFSET
    PARSER --> CUMMINS --> DAE
    DNV --> CLI
    OFFSET --> CLI
    CATENARY --> MO
    CATENARY --> SSP
    INDEX --> SYSML
    SYSML --> CLI
    INDEX --> DIAG --> IDE
    LINT --> LSP
```

## Pre-Flight Marine Linter Rules

### Diagnostics for SIMA / SIMO / RIFLEX (15 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7001` | error | `negative-metacentric-height` | Hydrostatic instability on vessel '<vessel>': negative <gmType> metacentric height (GM = <value> m < 0). |
| `M7002` | error | `line-length-underflow` | Mooring line '<line>' total length (<value> m) is less than water depth (<value> m), causing immediate vertical anchor snap load. |
| `M7003` | error | `acoustic-courant-violation` | Time step dt=<value>s exceeds Courant axial acoustic wave limit (<value>s) for segment '<seg>'. |
| `M7004` | error | `unconnected-attachment-node` | Mooring line '<line>' references unresolved fairlead attachment '<fairleadId>' not found on any vessel. |
| `M7005` | warning | `rao-frequency-extrapolation` | Environmental wave peak frequency (<value> rad/s) is outside hydrodynamic RAO table range [<value>, <value>] rad/s. |
| `M7006` | error | `invalid-stiffness-hierarchy` | Non-physical cross-sectional stiffness on segment '<seg>': <prop> (<val>) must be strictly positive. |
| `M7007` | warning | `unphysical-seabed-friction` | Unrealistic seabed friction coefficient (\\u03BC = <value>): expected value between 0.0 and 2.0. |
| `M7008` | error | `missing-hydrostatic-matrix` | Vessel '<vessel>' has zero or missing hydrostatic restoring matrix C; floating body cannot equilibrate in heave/roll/pitch. |
| `M7009` | error | `duplicate-line-identifier` | Duplicate line identifier '<id>' declared in the slender system. |
| `M7010` | warning | `slack-compression-hazard` | Mooring line '<line>' has negligible pre-tension under severe sea state (Hs > 8m), risking compression slack-snap loading. |
| `M7011` | warning | `morison-drag-unspecified` | Segment '<seg>' in wave zone has zero Morison drag coefficient (Cd = 0); hydrodynamic damping will be neglected. |
| `M7012` | warning | `anchor-uplift-warning` | Catenary line '<line>' exhibits vertical uplift angle (<value>\\xB0) at anchor; drag-embedment anchors will pull out. |
| `M7013` | error | `mass-matrix-asymmetric` | Vessel '<vessel>' structural mass matrix is asymmetric at index (<r>, <c>). |
| `M7014` | warning | `qtf-symmetry-violation` | Vessel '<vessel>' 2nd-order drift force QTF matrix violates conjugate symmetry. |
| `M7015` | error | `exceeds-minimum-bend-radius` | Line '<line>' minimum radius of curvature (<value> m) is below allowable MBR (<value> m). |

---

## Regulatory Verification & In-WASM Solvers

### 1. DNV-OS-E301 & DNV-ST-0119 Compliance

Evaluates line tension safety factors against Minimum Breaking Load (MBL):
$$S_F = \frac{T_{\text{MBL}}}{T_{\text{max}}} \ge 1.67 \quad (\text{Intact Condition})$$
$$S_F = \frac{T_{\text{MBL}}}{T_{\text{max}}} \ge 1.25 \quad (\text{Damaged / Single Line Broken})$$

### 2. Watch Circle & Touchdown Zone Verification

Computes vessel 6-DOF horizontal mean offset ellipse under coupled wind, wave drift, and current loads against allowable excursion limits (typically $\le 8\%$ water depth for intact, $\le 12\%$ for damaged). Checks fairlead declination angles ($\le 75^\circ$) and ensures anchor uplift angle is exactly $0^\circ$ for drag-embedment anchors.

### 3. ASTM E1049 Rainflow Fatigue & Palmgren-Miner Cumulative Damage

Extracts stress/tension reversal cycles using the ASTM E1049-85 four-point rainflow algorithm and computes cumulative fatigue damage using Palmgren-Miner's rule ($D = \text{DFF} \cdot \sum \frac{n_i}{N_i}$) against DNV-OS-E301 S-N curves for studless chain, stud link, spiral strand wire, and polyester ropes.

### 4. Cummins 6-DOF Dynamics with Rational State-Space Radiation

Replaces the integro-differential retardation convolution integral with an $O(p)$ rational linear state-space system ($\dot{z} = A_r z + B_r \dot{x}$, $\mu = C_r z + D_r \dot{x}$), converting the frequency-dependent memory terms into continuous 1st-order ODEs lowered directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` in linear WebAssembly memory.

---

## Headless CLI Operations (`msx sima`)

```bash
# Lint a SIMO / RIFLEX card deck or .sima XML archive
msx sima lint cases/OC4_Semi.inp

# Evaluate DNV-OS-E301 line tension safety factors against MBL
msx sima verify cases/OC4_Semi.inp --consequence-class=2

# Inspect floater watch circle, horizontal excursion, and touchdown clearances
msx sima offset cases/OC4_Semi.inp

# Inspect model summary (vessels, fairleads, lines, waves, wind)
msx sima summary cases/OC4_Semi.inp

# Synthesize acausal Modelica 6-DOF physical floater model
msx sima to-modelica cases/OC4_Semi.inp --out=OC4_Platform.mo

# Export multi-FMU SystemStructure.ssd co-simulation manifest
msx sima to-ssp cases/OC4_Semi.inp --out=SystemStructure.ssd

# Export formal SysML v2 architectural parts, ports, and DNV requirements
msx sima to-sysml2 cases/OC4_Semi.inp --out=OC4_Semi.sysml
```

# SPICE Electronics & Analog Circuit Simulation

ModelScript features high-performance native support for **SPICE** (`.cir`, `.sp`, `.net`, `.lib`) netlists and analog circuit analysis. Engineers can validate electrical schematics, detect topological faults (floating nodes, voltage source loops), execute pure in-WASM circuit simulations, and export to Modelica or ECAD netlist graphs.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                  | Extension             | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| :---------------------- | :-------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **SPICE Netlist**       | `.cir`, `.sp`, `.net` | Circuit description specifying passive components (R, L, C), active semiconductors (diode, BJT, MOSFET), independent/dependent sources, subcircuits, and simulation directives. |
| **SPICE Model Library** | `.lib`, `.mod`        | Device physics parameters for transistors, diodes, op-amps, and macro-models.                                                                                                   |

### Key Architectural Features

- **Engineering Unit Netlist Parser:**
  - Robust lexer parsing metric prefixes (`f`, `p`, `n`, `u`, `m`, `k`, `meg`, `g`, `t`), curly brace math expressions `{R1 * 2}`, line continuations (`+`), and subcircuit definitions (`.SUBCKT` / `.ENDS`).
  - Lossless round-trip serializer (`serializeSpice()`).
- **Native Numerical Solvers:**
  - **DC Operating Point (`.OP`):** Assembles Modified Nodal Analysis (MNA) matrix $\mathbf{G} \mathbf{v} = \mathbf{i}$ with Newton-Raphson iteration for non-linear PN junctions.
  - **Transient Simulation (`.TRAN`):** Numerical companion-circuit integration supporting Trapezoidal rule with damping for reactive elements ($L, C$).
  - **AC Small-Signal Frequency Sweep (`.AC`):** Complex admittance matrix $\mathbf{Y}(j\omega)$ solving decade/octave/linear frequency sweeps and bode response.
- **Circuit Linter Rules (`M7101`–`M7109`):**
  - Identifies single-connection floating nodes, parallel ideal voltage sources, cutsets of ideal current sources, non-positive passives, and subcircuit pin mismatches.
- **Bilateral Modelica & ECAD Projections:**
  - Translates SPICE netlists to standard `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` components.
  - Projects to generic `NetlistGraph` data structures for PCB layout, schematic capture, and Design Rule Checking (DRC).

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx spice`)

```bash
msx spice <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                        | Key Options                                                                           |
| :---------------- | :--------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **`simulate`**    | Runs DC operating point, transient, or AC analysis (AC sweep from the `.AC` card). | `--analysis op\|tran\|ac`, `--tstep`, `--tstop`, `--format table\|json\|csv`, `--out` |
| **`lint`**        | Runs pre-flight structural and electrical rule checks.                             | `--format`                                                                            |
| **`inspect`**     | Dumps topology, component breakdown, nodes, models, subcircuits, and directives.   | `--format`, `--out`                                                                   |
| **`to-modelica`** | Translates the netlist to Modelica 3.x electrical components and connections.      | `--out`                                                                               |
| **`to-ecad`**     | Projects the netlist to an ECAD netlist graph for PCB routing and DRC.             | `--out`                                                                               |
| **`to-dae`**      | Lowers the netlist directly into the linear-memory DAE arena.                      | `--format`, `--out`                                                                   |
| **`diagram`**     | Renders the circuit schematic to SVG or a JSON graph.                              | `--format`, `--out`                                                                   |
| **`sync`**        | Synchronizes tuned parameters and topology from Modelica back into the netlist.    | `--from-modelica`, `--strategy`, `--out`                                              |

### Examples

```bash
# Calculate DC bias voltages on all circuit nodes
msx spice simulate LowPassFilter.cir --analysis op

# Simulate transient step response and export trajectory
msx spice simulate PowerSupply.cir --analysis tran --tstep 1e-6 --tstop 0.01 --out transient.csv

# Run the AC frequency response defined by the netlist's .AC directive
msx spice simulate AudioAmplifier.sp --analysis ac --format csv --out bode.csv

# Lint netlist for floating electrical nodes and ground connectivity
msx spice lint SensorFrontEnd.net
```

---

# Verilog-A & Verilog-AMS Compact Modeling (`.va`, `.vams`)

`@modelscript/verilog-a` (`languages/verilog-a`) provides compiler, analog behavioral simulation, continuous DAE lowering, and SPICE netlist export for the **IEEE 1857 Verilog-A** and **Verilog-AMS** analog compact modeling language.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Standard / Format             | Description                                                     |
| :-------- | :---------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.va`     | **IEEE 1857 / OVI Verilog-A** | Continuous-time analog behavioral hardware description language |
| `.vams`   | **Accellera Verilog-AMS**     | Mixed-signal analog/digital compact device modeling             |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Analog Behavioral Disciplines & Natures

- Native support for physical disciplines and cross-domain nature definitions:
  - **Electrical**: Potential `Voltage` ($V$), Flow `Current` ($I$).
  - **Thermal**: Potential `Temperature` ($T$), Flow `Power` ($P$).
  - **Rotational / Mechanical**: Potential `Angle` ($\theta$), Flow `Torque` ($\tau$).
- Supports branch formulation, reference nodes (`ground`), and conservative multi-port Kirchhoff networks.

### 2. Analog Contribution Statements & Dynamic Operators

- Full evaluation of continuous-time analog contribution operators (`<+`):
  $$I(p, n) <+ I_{\text{sat}} \left( \exp\left(\frac{V(p, n)}{n V_t}\right) - 1 \right) + \frac{d}{dt}\left( C_j V(p, n) \right)$$
- **Dynamic Operators**: Time derivative `ddt(x)`, time integration `idt(x)`, transport delay `absdelay(x, td)`, and transition filters.
- **Transistor Compact Models**: Enables high-speed simulation of BSIM, EKV, diode, and custom micro-electro-mechanical (MEMS) behavioral models.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Lowers continuous behavioral equations, branch relations, and small-signal Jacobians directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Eliminates intermediate C-code generation or proprietary simulator compiling steps.

### 4. Polyglot Projections

- **Modelica (`verilogAToModelica`)**: Translates Verilog-A modules into acausal `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` component classes.
- **SPICE (`verilogAToSpice`)**: Generates equivalent SPICE subcircuit netlists (`.subckt`) with nonlinear behavioral voltage/current sources (`B`-sources).

---

## Static Analysis & Device Modeling Linter Rules

The Verilog-A linter detects compact modeling bugs and numerical convergence pitfalls:

### Diagnostics for Verilog-A / AMS (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7601` | error | `unassigned-analog-branch` | Electrical port pair '<p>' and '<n>' has no constitutive branch equation in analog block. |
| `M7602` | warning | `discontinuous-derivative-expression` | Discontinuous time-derivative operator '<func>()' used inside conditional branch statement. |
| `M7603` | error | `invalid-parameter-range` | Parameter '<name>' default value <val> violates declared range '<range>'. |
| `M7604` | warning | `unbounded-exponential-growth` | Unbounded exponential function 'exp()' used instead of safe 'limexp()' in '<ctx>'. |
| `M7605` | error | `port-discipline-mismatch` | Port '<port>' has no declared discipline or mismatch with module domain. |
| `M7606` | error | `undefined-node-reference` | Branch access '<branch>' references undeclared node '<node>'. |
| `M7607` | error | `duplicate-module-declaration` | Duplicate module declaration for '<name>'. |
| `M7608` | error | `zero-resistance-branch` | Potential contribution '<branch>' forms an unconstrained ideal short-circuit. |
| `M7609` | warning | `floating-internal-node` | Internal node '<node>' is declared but never referenced in any analog branch equation. |
| `M7610` | warning | `unsupported-analog-primitive` | Unsupported or deprecated analog primitive '<primitive>'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint a Verilog-A semiconductor device model
msx verilog-a lint MOS_Transistor.va

# Lower analog behavioral equations to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx verilog-a to-dae MOS_Transistor.va --out=transistor.dae.json

# Project into standard Modelica 3.x acausal analog component
msx verilog-a to-modelica MOS_Transistor.va -o MOS_Transistor.mo

# Export to SPICE subcircuit with nonlinear behavioral sources
msx verilog-a to-spice MOS_Transistor.va -o MOS_Transistor.sub
```

# IBIS Semiconductor Buffer Modeling (`.ibs`)

`@modelscript/ibis` (`languages/ibis`) provides zero-regex parsing, non-linear driver I/V interpolation, dynamic VT ramp synthesis, package parasitics RLC lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **ANSI/EIA-656 IBIS 3.2–7.1** input/output buffer information specifications.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format                    | Description                                                                         |
| :-------- | :------------------------ | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.ibs`    | IBIS Device Specification | Behavioral non-linear I/V tables, switching ramps, package parasitics, pin mappings |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Behavioral Non-Linear Driver & Receiver Formulation

- Replaces proprietary transistor-level SPICE netlists with behavioral table lookups that preserve intellectual property while accelerating high-speed digital signal integrity analysis:
  $$I_{\text{out}}(t) = k_u(t) \cdot I_{\text{pullup}}(V_{dd} - V_{\text{out}}) + k_d(t) \cdot I_{\text{pulldown}}(V_{\text{out}}) + I_{\text{gndclamp}}(V_{\text{out}}) + I_{\text{pwrclamp}}(V_{\text{out}} - V_{dd})$$
  where $k_u(t)$ and $k_d(t) \in [0, 1]$ are time-varying switching coefficients derived from the `[Ramp]` and `[Rising/Falling Waveform]` tables:
  $$\frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{V_{\text{swing}}}{t_r}, \quad \frac{dV}{dt} = \frac{V_{\text{swing}}}{t_f}$$
- Implements piecewise-linear monotonic cubic spline interpolation across Min/Typ/Max process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) operating corners.

### 2. Multi-Pin Package Parasitics

- Models chip-to-board interconnect parasitics via lumped RLC matrices and per-pin package values:
  $$V_{\text{pin}} - V_{\text{die}} = R_{\text{pkg}} I_{\text{pin}} + L_{\text{pkg}} \frac{dI_{\text{pin}}}{dt}$$
  $$I_{\text{die}} = I_{\text{pin}} - C_{\text{comp}} \frac{dV_{\text{die}}}{dt} - C_{\text{pkg}} \frac{dV_{\text{pin}}}{dt}$$
  where $C_{\text{comp}}$ is the silicon die capacitance.

### 3. Direct DAE Lowering

- Emits combined package RLC and non-linear buffer DAE equations into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.
- Enables co-simulation with multi-port S-parameter channel macromodels ([`@modelscript/touchstone`](./touchstone.md)) to assess eye diagrams, timing jitter, and simultaneous switching noise (SSN).

### 4. Bidirectional Modelica 3.x Projection

- Projects IBIS buffers into `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` non-linear controlled current sources and package RLC networks.

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The IBIS validator enforces monotonic I/V behavior and physical bounds:

### Diagnostics for IBIS (9 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8303` | warning | `non-monotonic-iv-curve` | IBIS model '<modelName>' contains non-monotonic slope in '<tableType>' table between <value>V and <value>V. |
| `M8305` | error | `missing-pin-model-binding` | Component pin '<pinName>' references undefined model '<modelName>'. |
| `M8316` | error | `missing-component-pins` | Component '<compName>' declaration has no defined pins in '[Pin]' section. |
| `M8317` | error | `invalid-voltage-range` | IBIS model '<modelName>' has invalid [Voltage Range]: min (<value>V) is greater than max (<value>V). |
| `M8318` | warning | `clamping-diode-divergence` | Model '<modelName>' clamp table '<clampType>' diverges to excessive current (<value>A). |
| `M8319` | error | `missing-pullup-pulldown` | Driver model '<modelName>' of type '<modelType>' is missing both I/V tables ([Pullup]/[Pulldown]) and [Ramp] slew rates. |
| `M8320` | error | `negative-die-capacitance` | IBIS model '<modelName>' specifies non-positive die capacitance C_comp '<val>'. |
| `M8321` | error | `negative-package-parasitic` | Component '<compName>' package parasitic '<param>' has non-positive value '<val>'. |
| `M8322` | error | `no-models-defined` | IBIS file contains no buffer [Model] definitions. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect pins, models, and package parasitics in an IBIS file
msx ibis inspect Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Run pre-flight linting and table monotonicity checks
msx ibis lint Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Evaluate driver dynamic currents and output resistance
msx ibis eval Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Lower buffer and package equations to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx ibis to-dae Ddr4Driver.ibs

# Project into Modelica 3.x electrical analog component
msx ibis to-modelica Ddr4Driver.ibs -o Ddr4Buffer.mo
```

# Touchstone RF & Signal Integrity (`.sNp`, `.ts`)

`@modelscript/touchstone` (`languages/touchstone`) provides high-performance zero-regex parsing, Vector Fitting rational macromodeling, Hamiltonian passivity enforcement, linear DAE lowering, and Modelica 3.x projection for **Touchstone 1.0 & 2.0** multi-port RF, microwave, and high-speed digital interconnect decks.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension              | Format             | Description                                                                                                   |
| :--------------------- | :----------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `.s1p`                 | 1-Port Network     | Reflection coefficient ($S_{11}$) for antennas, terminations, and single-ended loads                          |
| `.s2p`                 | 2-Port Network     | Transmission ($S_{21}, S_{12}$) and reflection ($S_{11}, S_{22}$) for filters, amplifiers, transmission lines |
| `.s3p`, `.s4p`, `.sNp` | Multi-Port Network | Multi-pin connectors, differential transmission lines, crosstalk matrices                                     |
| `.ts`                  | Touchstone 2.0     | Advanced multi-port specification with mixed-mode S-parameters and per-port reference impedances              |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Multi-Format Parameter Formats

- Parses multi-port frequency grids with automatic unit conversion (Hz, kHz, MHz, GHz) and parameter types:
  - **S-Parameters** (Scattering matrix)
  - **Y-Parameters** (Admittance matrix)
  - **Z-Parameters** (Impedance matrix)
  - **H / G Parameters** (Hybrid matrices)
- Supports all standard data formats:
  - **DB**: Magnitude in decibels ($20 \log_{10} |S|$), phase in degrees ($\angle S$)
  - **MA**: Linear magnitude ($|S|$), phase in degrees ($\angle S$)
  - **RI**: Real and imaginary components ($\text{Re}(S) + j \text{Im}(S)$)
- Enforces strict Touchstone matrix ordering conventions (e.g., $S_{21}, S_{12}$ transpose ordering for 2-port networks).

### 2. Vector Fitting & Rational Macromodeling

- Converts discrete frequency-domain tabulated measurements into continuous-time rational transfer functions via **Vector Fitting**:
  $$S_{ij}(s) \approx \sum_{m=1}^{P} \frac{r_m}{s - p_m} + d + s \cdot e$$
  where $p_m$ are complex conjugate pole pairs in the open left half-plane ($\text{Re}(p_m) < 0$), ensuring stability.
- Synthesizes a state-space realization:
  $$\dot{x}(t) = A x(t) + B u(t), \quad y(t) = C x(t) + D u(t)$$
  which lowers directly into ODE time-domain solvers without inverse FFT convolution lag.

### 3. Passivity Verification & Hamiltonian Matrix

- Verifies that the $N$-port network does not generate net energy across all frequencies:
  $$\|S(j\omega)\|_2 \le 1 \quad \forall \omega \in [0, \infty)$$
- Computes the eigenvalues of the **Hamiltonian matrix**:
  $$H = \begin{bmatrix} A + B (I - D^T D)^{-1} D^T C & B (I - D^T D)^{-1} B^T \\ -C^T (I - D D^T)^{-1} C & -(A + B (I - D^T D)^{-1} D^T C)^T \end{bmatrix}$$
  where purely imaginary eigenvalues identify exact passivity violation frequency crossover points.

### 4. Direct DAE Lowering & Modelica Projection

- Lowers state-space companion matrices directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena.
- Projects multiport networks into `Modelica.Electrical.Analog` pin networks for joint electro-mechanical and power electronic simulations ([`@modelscript/spice`](./spice.md)).

---

## Pre-Flight Diagnostics

The Touchstone linter checks physical validity and numerical stability:

### Diagnostics for Touchstone (10 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8301` | error | `passivity-violation` | N-port scattering matrix violates passivity criterion (spectral norm <norm> > 1.0) at frequency <freq>. |
| `M8302` | error | `causality-violation` | Kramers-Kronig causality relation violated across frequency sweep: '<detail>'. |
| `M8304` | error | `frequency-grid-non-monotonic` | Frequency grid is not monotonically increasing: step from <prevFreq> to <currFreq> is non-increasing. |
| `M8306` | warning | `missing-option-line` | Missing '#' option line; defaulting to '# GHz S MA R 50'. |
| `M8307` | error | `invalid-parameter-format` | Invalid Touchstone parameter token or format '<token>'. |
| `M8308` | error | `incomplete-matrix-data` | Incomplete N-port matrix row: expected <expected> values, received <received>. |
| `M8309` | error | `negative-reference-resistance` | Reference resistance '<r>' must be strictly positive. |
| `M8310` | warning | `asymmetric-reciprocal-network` | Asymmetry in reciprocal S-parameter network: \|S<i><j> - S<j><i>\| = <diff> exceeds threshold. |
| `M8311` | error | `no-frequency-points` | Touchstone file contains no valid frequency parameter points. |
| `M8312` | error | `duplicate-frequency-point` | Duplicate frequency sample point '<freq>' encountered in sweep. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect Touchstone port count, frequency range, and impedance
msx touchstone inspect BandpassFilter.s2p

# Run pre-flight linting and validity checks
msx touchstone lint BandpassFilter.s2p

# Verify S-parameter passivity and compute maximum singular value
msx touchstone passivity BandpassFilter.s2p

# Fit rational state-space macromodel via Vector Fitting
msx touchstone fit BandpassFilter.s2p --order=6

# Lower state-space model to ModelScript linear DAE arena
msx touchstone to-dae BandpassFilter.s2p

# Project into Modelica 3.x electrical analog component
msx touchstone to-modelica BandpassFilter.s2p -o FilterModel.mo
```

# Optical Transmission & OTDR Codecs (`.sor`, OpenROADM)

`@modelscript/optical` (`languages/optical`) provides binary codecs, physical layer solvers, and linear-memory DAE lowerings for **telecommunications optical transport networks, DWDM long-haul systems, and outside plant fiber diagnostics**.

---

## Supported Standards & Formats

| Format / Standard             | File Extensions  | Description                                                                                   |
| :---------------------------- | :--------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Telcordia / Bellcore OTDR** | `.sor`           | Telcordia GR-196-CORE & SR-4731 standard binary OTDR backscatter traces and key event tables  |
| **OpenROADM MSA**             | `.json`, `.yang` | OpenROADM Multi-Source Agreement (v7.1 / v13.1) ROADM nodes, CDC SRGs, degrees, and spans     |
| **TIP GNPy**                  | `.json`          | Telecom Infra Project Open Optical & Packet Transport (OOPT) network and equipment topologies |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Telcordia `.sor` Binary Codec & Metrics

- Fast zero-allocation binary parser and serializer for GR-196 / SR-4731 formats.
- Extracts `GenParams`, `SupParams`, `FxdParams`, `DataPts`, and `KeyEvents`.
- Computes fiber span metrics:
  - 2-point attenuation loss
  - Least-Squares Approximation (LSA) attenuation slope ($\text{dB/km}$)
  - Event loss ($\text{dB}$) and Fresnel reflectance ($\text{dB}$)
  - Optical Return Loss (ORL)

### 2. Generalized Gaussian Noise (EGN) Transmission Solver

- Evaluates non-linear interference (NLI) power spectral density across multi-span optical routes:
  $$G_{\text{nli}} = \frac{16}{27} \gamma^2 L_{\text{eff}} \frac{\text{asinh}\left(\frac{\pi^2}{2} |\beta_2| L_{\text{eff}} B_{\text{ch}}^2 N_{\text{ch}}^{2 \frac{B_{\text{ch}}}{\Delta f}}\right)}{\pi |\beta_2| B_{\text{ch}}}$$
- Solves Generalized Signal-to-Noise Ratio (GSNR) accounting for ASE noise and Kerr non-linearity:
  $$\text{GSNR}^{-1} = \text{OSNR}_{\text{ase}}^{-1} + \text{SNR}_{\text{nli}}^{-1}$$
- Computes accumulated chromatic dispersion ($\text{ps/nm}$), polarization mode dispersion (PMD), bit error rate (BER), and $Q$-factor.

### 3. Dynamic EDFA Gain Saturation DAE Lowering

- Lowers dynamic Erbium-Doped Fiber Amplifier (EDFA) gain saturation state equations directly to `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder`:
  $$\frac{dG}{dt} = \frac{G_0 - G}{\tau} - \frac{P_{\text{in}}}{P_{\text{sat}} \tau} G (G - 1)$$
  $$P_{\text{out}} = G \cdot P_{\text{in}}$$
- Allows continuous transient simulation of amplifier channel add/drop dynamics without wrapper AST overhead.

### 4. Precision Time Protocol (IEEE 1588 / SyncE) & Holdover

- Evaluates ITU-T G.8275.1 time error budgets ($cTE \le 5\text{ ns}$ per hop, $dTE$, MTIE, and TDEV).
- Validates 3GPP 5G TDD base station synchronization ($\pm 1.5\ \mu\text{s}$) and intra-cluster CoMP alignment ($\le 130\text{ ns}$).
- Models local oscillator phase drift during GNSS outages (OCXO, DOCXO, Rubidium, CSAC).

---

## Pre-Flight Optical Transport Lint Rules

### Diagnostics for OpenROADM & Telcordia .sor (7 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M1001` | error | `osnr-margin-exhausted` | Channel '<channelId>' GSNR (<gsnrDb> dB) is below required FEC threshold (<requiredDb> dB). |
| `M1002` | warning | `edfa-input-power-underflow` | Amplifier '<ampId>' input power (<inputDbm> dBm) is below operational sensitivity threshold (<sensitivityDbm> dBm). |
| `M1003` | warning | `nonlinear-power-threshold-exceeded` | Span '<spanId>' total launch power (<powerDbm> dBm) exceeds non-linear Kerr threshold (<thresholdDbm> dBm). |
| `M1004` | error | `roadm-colorless-contention` | ROADM '<nodeId>' SRG bank <srgNum> has frequency contention at <freqThz> THz between '<ch1>' and '<ch2>'. |
| `M1005` | error | `uncompensated-chromatic-dispersion` | Channel '<channelId>' accumulated chromatic dispersion (<accumPsPerNm> ps/nm) exceeds DSP buffer limit (<limitPsPerNm> ps/nm). |
| `M1006` | error | `otdr-high-loss-event` | OTDR Event #<evNum> at NaNm specifies high loss (<lossDb> dB), exceeding max allowable (<maxDb> dB). |
| `M1007` | error | `srlg-diversity-violation` | Protection pair '<ch1>' and '<ch2>' share common-risk conduit/trench '<srlgId>'. |

---

## CLI Usage (`msx optical`)

```bash
# Inspect Telcordia .sor OTDR trace events or OpenROADM network topology
msx optical inspect trace.sor
msx optical otdr trace.sor

# Solve multi-span DWDM GSNR, OSNR, and Shannon capacity
msx optical gsnr --distance=320 --span-len=80 --baud=64 --power=0.0 --edfa-nf=5.5

# Run static pre-flight optical transport lint rules
msx optical lint network.json

# Lower dynamic EDFA gain saturation ODEs to the linear-memory DAE arena
msx optical to-dae network.json --out=optical.dae
```

# RAN & Microwave Propagation (`.adf`, `.pat`, ITU-R P.530)

`@modelscript/ran` (`languages/ran`) provides antenna pattern ingestion, 3D envelope synthesis, and microwave link propagation modeling for **cellular Radio Access Networks (4G/5G), fixed wireless access (FWA), and utility microwave backhaul**.

---

## Supported Standards & Formats

| Format / Standard       | File Extensions | Description                                                                                              |
| :---------------------- | :-------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **NSMA WG16.99.050**    | `.adf`, `.nsma` | National Spectrum Management Association standardized antenna radiation patterns (azimuth and elevation) |
| **Planet / TIA-329**    | `.pat`, `.msi`  | Industry-standard Planet and TIA-329 antenna pattern decks                                               |
| **ITU-R P.530-18**      | Specification   | International Telecommunication Union rain fade attenuation and availability prediction                  |
| **ITU-R P.838 / P.837** | Specification   | Specific rain attenuation coefficients ($\gamma = k R^\alpha$) and digital rain maps                     |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. 2D/3D Antenna Radiation Pattern Interpolation

- Parses dual-polarized horizontal and vertical antenna gain cuts across $360^\circ$ azimuth and $\pm 90^\circ$ elevation.
- Computes half-power beamwidth (HPBW, 3 dB) and front-to-back (F/B) ratios.
- Bicubic 3D gain envelope interpolation with electrical and mechanical downtilt:
  $$G(\theta, \phi) = G_{\text{peak}} - \min\left(-(A_H(\phi) + A_V(\theta - \theta_{\text{tilt}})), A_m\right)$$

### 2. Microwave Link Budget & ITU-R P.530 Rain Fade

- Computes Free Space Path Loss (FSPL) and atmospheric absorption:
  $$\text{FSPL}(\text{dB}) = 20 \log_{10}(d) + 20 \log_{10}(f) + 92.45$$
- Solves ITU-R P.530-18 rain attenuation for $0.01\%$ of time ($A_{0.01} = \gamma_R \cdot d_{\text{eff}}$) and annual link availability percent (verifying "five-nines" $99.999\%$ uptime).

### 3. Fresnel Zone Clearance & Earth Curvature

- Computes 1st Fresnel zone radius along the propagation path:
  $$F_1 = 17.32 \sqrt{\frac{d_1 d_2}{f \cdot D}}$$
- Evaluates Earth curvature bulge ($h_{\text{bulge}} = \frac{d_1 d_2}{12.74 k}$) using effective Earth radius factor $k = 4/3$.
- Identifies terrain and obstacle obstructions where clearance ratio falls below the $0.60 F_1$ threshold.

### 4. FCC OET Bulletin 65 & ICNIRP 2020 RF Radiation Safety (MPE)

- Computes near-field and far-field power density ($S = \frac{\text{EIRP}}{4\pi R^2}$ with ground reflection) across multi-operator colocation sites.
- Evaluates occupational/controlled and general-public/uncontrolled Maximum Permissible Exposure (MPE) horizontal and vertical exclusion boundaries.

### 5. FAA 14 CFR Part 77, ICAO Annex 14 & Transport Canada Airspace Obstruction

- Evaluates proposed cellular and microwave towers against FAA Part 77 imaginary surfaces (primary, approach, transitional, horizontal, conical), 200-ft AGL notice criteria, ICAO Annex 14 Obstacle Limitation Surfaces (OLS), and Transport Canada TP 312 / CAR 601.

---

## Regulatory Pre-Flight Lint Rules

### Diagnostics for NSMA WG16 & Planet Antenna (5 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M2001` | error | `fresnel-zone-obstruction` | Microwave link '<linkId>' has terrain obstacle at <distKm> km penetrating 1st Fresnel zone (clearance ratio <ratio> < 0.60). |
| `M2002` | warning | `link-availability-sub-five-nines` | Microwave link '<linkId>' annual availability (<avail>%) is below 99.999% SLA (<unavailMin> minutes/year outage). |
| `M2003` | error | `fcc-eirp-limit-exceeded` | Microwave link '<linkId>' EIRP (<eirpDbm> dBm) exceeds regulatory FCC Part 101 ceiling (<maxDbm> dBm). |
| `M2004` | error | `polarization-mismatch` | Link '<linkId>' declares polarization '<txPol>' but antenna specifies incompatible '<antPol>'. |
| `M2005` | warning | `antenna-downtilt-out-of-bounds` | Antenna '<antenna>' declares electrical downtilt (<tilt> deg) outside typical operational range [0.0, 16.0 deg]. |

---

## CLI Usage (`msx ran`)

```bash

msx ran microwave --freq=11.0 --dist=15.0 --tx-power=20.0 --tx-gain=38.0

# Generate FCC Part 101 Prior Coordination Notice (PCN) microwave engineering exhibit
msx ran pcn --freq=11.0 --dist=15.0

# Evaluate FCC OET-65 / ICNIRP 2020 RF Maximum Permissible Exposure (MPE) safety zones

# Evaluate FAA 14 CFR Part 77 airspace obstruction and Form 7460-1 notice criteria
msx ran faa --dist=15.0

# Inspect NSMA WG16 (.adf) or Planet (.pat) antenna radiation pattern files
msx ran antenna sector_65deg.adf

# Evaluate 1st Fresnel zone clearance and Earth curvature bulge
msx ran fresnel --freq=11.0 --dist=15.0
```

# Fiber Outside Plant & SRLG Cadastre (TIA-598-D, GeoJSON)

`@modelscript/fiber` (`languages/fiber`) provides outside plant (OSP) civil infrastructure modeling, strand-level optical routing, and physical route diversity analysis for **telecom carriers, metro fiber utilities, and critical infrastructure networks**.

---

## Supported Standards & Formats

| Format / Standard        | File Extensions     | Description                                                                                              |
| :----------------------- | :------------------ | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **ANSI/TIA-598-D**       | Specification       | Standardized optical fiber cable color coding (12-color sequence) for buffer tubes, ribbons, and strands |
| **GeoJSON OSP Cadastre** | `.geojson`, `.json` | Geographic Outside Plant network schema for cables, ducts, utility poles, manholes, and splice closures  |
| **SRLG Risk Models**     | `.json`             | Shared Risk Link Group specifications for physical routing diversity verification                        |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. ANSI/TIA-598-D 12-Color Registry

- Full resolution of standard telecom color sequence:
  1. Blue, 2. Orange, 3. Green, 4. Brown, 5. Slate, 6. White, 7. Red, 8. Black, 9. Yellow, 10. Violet, 11. Rose, 12. Aqua.
- Hierarchical identification of high-count cables (up to 864+ fibers) with striped buffer tubes and bundle binders.

### 2. Multi-Hop Optical Strand Tracing

- Traces continuous optical lightpaths from Central Office (CO) Optical Distribution Frames (ODF) across cables, patch panels, and fusion splices down to customer demarcation points.
- Accounts for fusion splice insertion loss, connector reflections, and cable sheath lengths.

### 3. Shared Risk Link Group (SRLG) Disjointness

- Evaluates physical path isolation between primary and backup protection circuits:
  $$\text{SRLG}(P_{\text{primary}}) \cap \text{SRLG}(P_{\text{backup}}) = \emptyset$$
- Detects physical Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) where supposedly diverse customer circuits share common trenches, duct banks, utility poles, or bridge crossings.
- Calculates Jaccard physical diversity scores.

### 4. OTDR-to-GIS GPS Fault Geolocation

- Pinpoints the physical GPS latitude/longitude of fiber breaks or high-loss anomalies detected by OTDR traces.
- Applies cable helical twisting correction factor ($H = 1.01$–$1.05$):
  $$d_{\text{physical}} = \frac{d_{\text{optical}}}{H}$$
- Corrects for slack storage coils stored in vaults, manholes, and aerial snowshoes.
- Identifies the closest upstream and downstream access enclosures to dispatch emergency restoration crews directly to the proper vault.

### 5. NESC C2 Pole Loading, Make-Ready & FCC BDC H3 Fabric

- Solves aerial catenary sag-tension under NESC Heavy, Medium, Light, and Extreme Wind loading zones, and audits utility pole ground-line bending moment utilization and NESC Rule 235/238 vertical communication-to-supply clearances (plus CSA C22.3 No. 1 and Eurocode EN 1991-1-4).
- Discretizes fiber service polygons into Uber H3 resolution-8/9/10 hexagonal cells (`discretizeCoverageToH3`) for FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC) filings.

---

## Pre-Flight Outside Plant Lint Rules

*No static linter rules catalogued for `fiber`.*

---

## CLI Usage (`msx fiber`)

```bash
# Convert OTDR optical fault distance into exact WGS84 GIS coordinates with helix slack correction
msx fiber locate route.geojson --distance=4250 --helix=1.03

# Trace end-to-end fiber strand connectivity and splice budget
msx fiber trace network.json --cable=CBL-101 --strand=12

msx fiber srlg network.json

# Resolve ANSI/TIA-598-D buffer tube and fiber strand color codes

# Discretize fiber coverage polygons into FCC Broadband Data Collection (BDC) H3 hexagons

msx fiber make-ready --prop-height=21
```

# URDF & Xacro Robot Kinematics

ModelScript provides first-class support for **URDF** (`.urdf`) and **Xacro** (`.xacro`), the robotics industry and ROS (Robot Operating System) standard for describing kinematic trees, inertial properties, visual geometry, and joint limits of robotic manipulators, humanoids, and autonomous vehicles.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                               | Extension       | Description                                                                                                                                                       |
| :----------------------------------- | :-------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Unified Robot Description Format** | `.urdf`, `.xml` | XML schema defining kinematic links, joints (revolute, continuous, prismatic, fixed, floating, planar), inertial parameters, collision bounds, and visual meshes. |
| **Xacro Macro Template**             | `.xacro`        | Parametric XML preprocessor adding variables (`<xacro:property>`), mathematical expressions, and reusable macros (`<xacro:macro>`).                               |

### Key Architectural Features

- **Xacro Expansion & Parser:**
  - Robust XML reader with automatic in-memory macro expansion (`<xacro:macro>`) and mathematical expression evaluation before parsing.
  - Generates strongly typed robot AST representation via `parseUrdf()`.
- **Topological Kinematic Tree & Featherstone Algorithms:**
  - Traverses joint-link connectivity starting from the root base link.
  - Implements **Recursive Newton-Euler Algorithm (RNEA)** for inverse dynamics: calculates required joint torques $\boldsymbol{\tau}$ given joint positions $\mathbf{q}$, velocities $\dot{\mathbf{q}}$, and accelerations $\ddot{\mathbf{q}}$.
  - Implements **Articulated-Body Algorithm (ABA)** for forward dynamics: evaluates forward acceleration $\ddot{\mathbf{q}} = \mathbf{M}(\mathbf{q})^{-1} (\boldsymbol{\tau} - \mathbf{C}(\mathbf{q}, \dot{\mathbf{q}}) - \mathbf{g}(\mathbf{q}))$ in $O(N)$ operations.
- **Robotics Linters (`M7501`–`M7508`):**
  - Detects dangling parent/child link references, disconnected kinematic sub-trees, inverted joint limits (`lower > upper`), zero joint axis vectors, missing inertia tags, and non-physical inertia tensors.
- **Multi-Target Projections:**
  - **Modelica MultiBody:** Synthesizes `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` robotic arms with joint friction and actuator controllers.
  - **MSC Adams:** Exports Adams `.adm` solver datasets.
  - **SIMPACK:** Generates SIMPACK `.spck` mechanisms.
  - **3D CAD:** Projects robot geometry into CSG primitives and STEP visual meshes.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx urdf`)

```bash
msx urdf <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                   | Key Options                                        |
| :---------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------- |
| **`lint`**        | Runs kinematic tree validation, joint limit checks, and inertia verification. | —                                                  |
| **`rnea`**        | Evaluates inverse dynamics (RNEA) at test joint coordinates.                  | `--gravity`                                        |
| **`simulate`**    | Solves articulated robot forward dynamics into time-series trajectories.      | `--stop-time`, `--step-size`, `--format=csv\|json` |
| **`to-modelica`** | Generates standard `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` robot system.               | `--out=<file.mo>`                                  |
| **`to-adams`**    | Projects robot mechanism into MSC Adams `.adm` solver dataset.                | `--out=<file.adm>`                                 |
| **`to-simpack`**  | Projects robot mechanism into SIMPACK XML `.spck` model.                      | `--out=<file.spck>`                                |
| **`to-usd`**      | Projects robot into OpenUSD / UsdPhysics scene or 64-byte aligned package.    | `--usdz`, `--out=<file.usda\|file.usdz>`           |
| **`to-dae`**      | Lowers kinematic state equations directly into `DAEBuilder` arena.            | —                                                  |

### Examples

```bash
# Simulate forward dynamics under gravity to CSV/JSON trajectory
msx simulate KukaIiwa14.urdf --stop-time=2.0 --step-size=0.01 -o trajectory.csv

# Evaluate inverse dynamics (RNEA) static hold torques
msx urdf rnea KukaIiwa14.urdf

# Check for inverted joint limits or dangling parent links
msx urdf lint MobileManipulator.urdf

# Convert robot description into standard Modelica 3.x
msx urdf to-modelica PandaArm.urdf --out=PandaArm.mo

# Export to OpenUSD / UsdPhysics digital twin scene
msx urdf to-usd PandaArm.urdf --out=PandaArm.usda

# Export to 64-byte aligned USDZ package for Apple Vision Pro & NVIDIA Omniverse
msx urdf to-usd PandaArm.urdf --usdz --out=PandaArm.usdz

# Export to MSC Adams for vehicle-mounted robot simulation
msx urdf to-adams RoverArm.urdf --out=RoverArm.adm
```

---

## Interactive Ansatz Web Platform (`UrdfViewer`)

On [Ansatz](https://ansatz.social), `.urdf`, `.sdf`, and `.xacro` artifacts render directly in the interactive **Robotics Mechanism Studio**:

- **Kinematic Tree View**: High-resolution vector schematic visualizing parent/child links and joint types with pan-and-zoom controls.
- **3D Pose View**: Real-time WebGPU/Three.js multibody viewport with forward kinematics joint angle sliders ($q_i \in [q_{\text{min}}, q_{\text{max}}]$).
- **Dynamics & Linter**: Pre-flight verification results (`M7501`–`M7508`) paired with an **RNEA Gravity Hold Torques** calculator reporting static equilibrium torques ($\tau_i \text{ [N}\cdot\text{m]}$).
- **Polyglot Projections**: One-click translation to Modelica 3.x or SIMPACK JSON, with direct export to the Ansatz Morsel visual simulator.

---

# PLCopen XML & IEC 61131-3 Industrial Automation (`.xml`, `.st`)

`@modelscript/plcopen` (`languages/plcopen`) provides compiler, Virtual PLC cyclic execution, sampled-data DAE lowering, and formal verification for **IEC 61131-3** industrial control software and **PLCopen XML** interchange models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension          | Standard / Format               | Description                                                                    |
| :----------------- | :------------------------------ | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.xml`, `.plcopen` | **PLCopen XML v2.01 / v2.0**    | XML exchange format for IEC 61131-3 control programs, POUs, and configurations |
| `.st`              | **IEC 61131-3 Structured Text** | Textual structured control language for PLCs and industrial controllers        |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. IEC 61131-3 Program Organization Units (POUs)

- Full support for standard control logic paradigms:
  - **Structured Text (ST)**: Variable declarations, conditionals (`IF-THEN-ELSE`), case selection, loops (`FOR`, `WHILE`), and mathematical expressions.
  - **Function Blocks (FB)**: State-retaining functional blocks including standard timers (`TON`, `TOF`, `TP`), counters (`CTU`, `CTD`, `CTUD`), and bistable multivibrators (`SR`, `RS`).
  - **Functions (FUN)**: Pure stateless mathematical computations.

### 2. High-Speed Deterministic Virtual PLC Engine

- Features a cycle-accurate Virtual PLC execution runtime (`VirtualPlc`):
  - **Sampled Scan Cycle**: Deterministic three-phase execution: input latching $\to$ logic evaluation $\to$ output write.
  - **Configurable Scan Period**: Executes discrete scan rates (e.g., $1\,\text{ms}$, $10\,\text{ms}$, $50\,\text{ms}$) coupled with continuous physical models.

### 3. Direct Sampled-Data DAE Lowering

- Compiles discrete state variables, zero-order holds (ZOH), and timer registers into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` arena.
- Enables closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation of PLC control algorithms coupled with continuous Modelica physics (e.g., thermal plants, robotic actuators, motor drives).

### 4. Polyglot Projections

- **Modelica (`plcopenToModelica`)**: Lowers PLC function blocks into standard synchronous Modelica clocked state machines.
- **SysML v2 (`plcopenToSysML`)**: Maps IEC 61131-3 control architectures to SysML v2 `action def` successions and state machines.

---

## Static Analysis & Safety Linter Rules

### Diagnostics for PLCopen / IEC 61131-3 (13 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M7701` | error | `unassigned-variable-read` | Variable '<name>' is read before being assigned or initialized in POU '<pouName>'. |
| `M7702` | warning | `cyclic-task-overrun` | Computational complexity in task '<taskName>' (<stmtCount> statements) may exceed cycle time '<interval>'. |
| `M7703` | error | `recursive-pou-call` | Recursive invocation of POU '<calleeName>' detected in '<callerName>'. Recursion is prohibited in IEC 61131-3. |
| `M7704` | error | `io-mapping-collision` | Hardware I/O address collision at '<address>': multiple variables ('<var1>', '<var2>') assigned to same output. |
| `M7705` | error | `type-mismatch-assignment` | Type mismatch in assignment to '<varName>': expected '<expectedType>', got '<actualType>'. |
| `M7706` | error | `timer-preset-negative` | Timer preset time '<value>' for '<timerName>' cannot be negative. |
| `M7707` | warning | `unbounded-loop-detected` | Loop in POU '<pouName>' does not have a deterministic bounded termination condition. |
| `M7708` | error | `unknown-pou-type` | Unknown or unresolvable POU or function block type '<typeName>' instantiated in '<instanceName>'. |
| `M7709` | warning | `unreachable-code` | Unreachable code detected after '<stmtKind>' statement in POU '<pouName>'. |
| `M7710` | error | `invalid-task-interval` | Task '<taskName>' specifies invalid or non-positive periodic interval '<interval>'. |
| `M7711` | warning | `retain-without-non-volatile-storage` | Variable '<varName>' in '<pouName>' declared RETAIN but PLC configuration lacks non-volatile memory backup. |
| `M7712` | error | `division-by-zero-in-expression` | Constant expression in POU '<pouName>' evaluates to division by zero. |
| `M7713` | error | `unresolved-function-block` | Function block instance '<fbName>' in '<pouName>' does not resolve to a declared FunctionBlock. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Lint an IEC 61131-3 PLCopen XML project
msx plcopen lint AutomationController.xml

# Run 50 discrete scan cycles (dt = 10ms) through the Virtual PLC engine
msx plcopen run-scan AutomationController.xml --cycles 50 --dt 10

# Lower control logic to DAE arena for closed-loop physics co-simulation
msx plcopen to-dae AutomationController.xml --out=controller.dae.json

# Project into Modelica synchronous clocked state machine components
msx plcopen to-modelica AutomationController.xml -o ControllerBlocks.mo
```

# IEC 62714 AutomationML & CAEX Plant Topology (`.aml`, `.caex`, `.amlx`)

`@modelscript/automationml` (`languages/automationml`) provides native WebAssembly parsing, CAEX 2.15 / 3.0 hierarchy and `InternalLink` validation, discrete-event virtual commissioning simulation, `DAEBuilder` lowering, and SSP / SysML v2 / Modelica projections for **IEC 62714 AutomationML** industrial automation and mechatronic plant engineering models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format                 | Description                                                                                                    |
| :-------- | :--------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.aml`    | IEC 62714 AutomationML | XML document combining CAEX plant topology, COLLADA 3D geometry/kinematics references, and PLCopen logic links |
| `.caex`   | IEC 62424 CAEX         | Computer Aided Engineering Exchange XML (CAEX 2.15 & 3.0)                                                      |
| `.amlx`   | AutomationML Container | Packaged AutomationML archive bundling `.aml` topologies with referenced `.dae` and `.plcxml` artifacts        |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Four-Pillar CAEX Plant Architecture

- Parses and validates all four CAEX object-oriented libraries inside `CAEXFile`:
  - **`InstanceHierarchy`**: Concrete plant cells, robots, conveyors, sensors, and PLC controllers (`InternalElement`).
  - **`SystemUnitClassLib`**: Reusable mechatronic equipment templates and vendor device catalogs.
  - **`RoleClassLib`**: Semantic engineering roles (`Resource`, `Product`, `Process`, `MechatronicAssembly`).
  - **`InterfaceClassLib`**: Typed external connectors (`ExternalInterface`: `COLLADAInterface`, `PLCopenXmlInterface`, `SignalInterface`, `Order`).

### 2. Virtual Commissioning & Scan-Cycle Simulation

- Executes deterministic discrete-time scan-cycle virtual commissioning (`runAmlVirtualCommissioning`) across linked actuators, sensors, and controller interfaces.
- Lowers continuous and discrete mechatronic state equations directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena.

### 3. Multi-Domain Projections (SSP, SysML v2, Modelica)

- **SSP 1.0 (`amlToSsp`)**: Generates `SystemStructure.ssd` co-simulation topologies from AutomationML `InstanceHierarchy` and `InternalLink` connections.
- **OMG SysML v2 (`amlToSysML2`)**: Maps `InternalElement` hierarchies and `ExternalInterface` ports to SysML v2 `part` and `port` usages.
- **Modelica 3.x (`amlToModelica`)**: Synthesizes connected acausal Modelica plant models.

---

# Adams-Compatible Multibody Dynamics

ModelScript features comprehensive, native support for **Adams-compatible** (`.adm`, `.cmd`) mechanism modeling, the classic industrial standard for mechanical systems simulation and multibody dynamics (MBD). Engineers can parse legacy Adams View command files and solver datasets, perform Grübler-Kutzbach spatial mobility analysis, evaluate 3D joint constraint residuals, and project mechanisms to modern SIMPACK and Modelica formats.

---

## Capabilities & Supported Formats

| Format                      | Extension | Description                                                                                                                                                           |
| :-------------------------- | :-------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Adams Solver Dataset**    | `.adm`    | Numerical dataset specifying rigid parts (`PART`), marker frames (`MARKER`), kinematic joints (`JOINT`), force elements (`SPRINGDAMPER`, `BUSHING`), and constraints. |
| **Adams View Command File** | `.cmd`    | Interactive parametric command scripts defining mechanism geometry, design variables, and simulation runs.                                                            |

### Key Architectural Features

- **Lexer & Parser:**
  - Robust deck ingestion supporting scientific notation (`1.5D-03`), inline comments (`!`), line continuations (`...`), and block cards.
  - Lossless serialization back to standardized `.adm` solver format via `serializeAdams()`.
- **Spatial 3D Kinematics:**
  - Full evaluation of Euler 3-1-3 and Tait-Bryan 1-2-3 rotation matrices.
  - Analytical joint constraint formulation for standard spatial joint primitives (Revolute, Spherical, Prismatic, Cylindrical, Planar, Universal).
- **Grübler-Kutzbach Mobility Analysis:**
  - Calculates mechanism degrees of freedom ($M = 6(n - 1) - \sum c_i$).
  - Identifies redundant kinematic constraints and overconstrained multi-loop linkages.
- **Multibody Linters (`M7301`–`M7310`):**
  - Flags missing ground parts, dangling marker references, unphysical inertia tensors violating the triangle inequality ($I_{xx} + I_{yy} \ge I_{zz}$), massless moving parts, and negative spring/damping parameters.
- **Cross-Domain Projections:**
  - **SIMPACK MBD:** Maps parts, markers, and spatial joints to SIMPACK `.spck` XML models.
  - **Modelica MultiBody:** Synthesizes standard `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody` parts and joint components.

---

## Command Line Interface (`msx adams`)

```bash
msx adams <action> [files...] [options]
```

| Action            | Description                                                                    | Key Options                                                     |
| :---------------- | :----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **`lint`**        | Runs structural validation, inertia verification, and kinematic sanity checks. | —                                                               |
| **`mobility`**    | Evaluates spatial degrees of freedom and overconstrained loops.                | —                                                               |
| **`to-simpack`**  | Projects Adams mechanism to SIMPACK XML (`.spck`).                             | `--out=<file.spck>`                                             |
| **`to-modelica`** | Projects Adams mechanism to `Modelica.Mechanics.MultiBody`.                    | `--out=<file.mo>`                                               |
| **`simulate`**    | Lowers to a DAE and integrates it in time.                                     | `--stop-time`, `--step`, `--stabilization=baumgarte\|algebraic` |

### Examples

```bash
# Calculate mechanism spatial degrees of freedom
msx adams mobility FourBarLinkage.adm

# Validate inertia tensors and marker references
msx adams lint LandingGear.adm

# Convert Adams dataset into SIMPACK XML format
msx adams to-simpack RobotArm.adm --out=RobotArm.spck

# Compute mechanism mobility (degrees of freedom)
msx adams mobility ExcavatorMechanism.adm
```

---

## Multibody Linters & Diagnostic Rules

| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| `M7307` | warning | `coincident-joint-markers` | Joint '<jointId>' uses identical I and J markers ('<iMarker>'). |

| `M7310` | warning | `unconstrained-part` | Part '<partId>' is completely disconnected from joints or force elements (floating rigid body). |

# EnergyPlus Building Simulation (`.idf`, `.epjson`)

`@modelscript/energyplus` (`languages/energyplus`) provides compiler, thermal lumped-capacitance DAE lowering, and bidirectional TGG synchronization for **US Department of Energy (DOE) EnergyPlus** building energy and HVAC models.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format                     | Description                                                          |
| :-------- | :------------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.idf`    | EnergyPlus Input Data File | Industry-standard comma/semicolon delimited building simulation deck |
| `.epjson` | EnergyPlus JSON Schema     | Structured JSON schema representation of EnergyPlus models           |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Lumped-Capacitance Multi-Zone Thermal DAEs

- Translates architectural thermal zones and building envelopes into continuous energy balance DAEs:
  $$C_{z,i} \frac{dT_{z,i}}{dt} = \sum_{j} \dot{Q}_{\text{cond},ij} + \sum_{k} \dot{Q}_{\text{conv},ik} + \dot{Q}_{\text{solar}} + \dot{Q}_{\text{internal}} + \dot{Q}_{\text{HVAC}}$$
- **Envelope Conduction**: Multi-layer wall, floor, and roof constructions with layer-resolved thermal conductivity $k$, density $\rho$, and specific heat $c_p$.
- **Window & Fenestration Optics**: U-factor, Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC), and visible transmittance shading calculations.
- **Internal Loads**: Schedules for lighting, occupancy sensible/latent heat release, and plug-load equipment dissipation.

### 2. Direct DAE Lowering

- Compiles building geometry and HVAC schedules directly into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` linear memory arena, enabling co-simulation with dynamic grid power models ([`@modelscript/pscad`](./pscad.md)) and district energy networks.

### 3. Bidirectional Triple Graph Grammar (TGG) Sync

- Implements bidirectional TGG rules (`energyplus-sync.ts`) synchronizing EnergyPlus thermal zones with:
  - **Modelica (`Modelica.Thermal` / IBPSA Buildings)**: Automatic translation into acausal thermal components and fluid loops.
  - **STEP CAD (ISO 10303)**: Validates physical geometric volume and boundary surface areas against 3D architectural CAD envelopes.

---

## Static Analysis & Pre-Flight Linter Rules

| `M7908` | error | `zero-thickness-material` | Opaque material '<matName>' has invalid non-positive thickness (<value>m). |

# EPANET Water Distribution Networks (`.inp`)

`@modelscript/epanet` (`languages/epanet`) provides native parsing, hydraulic simulation, DAE lowering, and formal verification for **US EPA EPANET** pressurized drinking water distribution networks and municipal water infrastructure.

---

## Supported Extensions & Standards

| Extension | Format            | Description                                                                       |
| :-------- | :---------------- | :-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `.inp`    | EPANET Input File | Industry-standard network topology, pipes, pumps, valves, and water quality decks |

---

## Key Capabilities

### 1. Todini Global Gradient Method (GGM) Hydraulic Solver

- Implements the Todini Global Gradient Algorithm (`todini-ggm.ts`) for quadratic/nonlinear pipe network equilibrium:
  - **Conservation of Mass at Junctions**:
    $$\sum_{k \in \text{in}(i)} Q_k - \sum_{k \in \text{out}(i)} Q_k = D_i$$
  - **Conservation of Energy across Pipe Loops**:
    $$h_i - h_j = h_{L,ij} = r Q_{ij} |Q_{ij}|^{\alpha - 1}$$
- Supports **Hazen-Williams**, **Darcy-Weisbach**, and **Chezy-Manning** head loss friction models.

### 2. Multi-Component Hydraulic Elements

- **Pumps**: Head gain curves modeled via 3-point polynomial and power-law relationships ($h_p = h_0 - a Q^b$).
- **Tanks & Reservoirs**: Dynamic elevated storage tanks with hydrostatic pressure differential equations:
  $$A_{\text{tank}} \frac{dh}{dt} = \sum Q_{\text{in}} - \sum Q_{\text{out}}$$
- **Control Valves**: Pressure Reducing Valves (PRV), Pressure Sustaining Valves (PSV), and Flow Control Valves (FCV).

### 3. Extended-Period, Pressure-Driven, MOC Water Hammer, Quality & AWWA M36

- **Extended Period Simulation (`eps`) & Optimal Pump Scheduling (`ops`)**: Simulates 24–168 hour diurnal demand patterns and tank storage cycles while optimizing pump energy against time-of-use electricity tariffs.
- **Wagner Pressure-Driven Demand (`pdd`) & Fire Flow**: Evaluates pressure-deficient delivery ($Q_i = D_i \sqrt{(P_i - P_{\min}) / (P_{\text{req}} - P_{\min})}$) and ISO hydrant residual pressure limits ($\ge 20\text{ psi}$).
- **Method of Characteristics (MOC) Water Hammer (`surge`)**: Solves 1D elastic Joukowsky wave propagation ($\Delta H = \pm \frac{a}{g} \Delta V$) for rapid valve closure and pump trip transients.
- **Advective Water Quality (`quality`), AWWA M36 Water Audit (`audit`), GIS Ingestion (`from-gis`) & EPA LCRR**: Models chlorine decay and water age, computes Infrastructure Leakage Index (ILI), ingests GeoJSON pipe/node layers, and exports US EPA Lead and Copper Rule Revisions (LCRR) inventories.

### 4. Direct DAE Lowering & Modelica Projection

- Compiles the entire municipal pipe and tank network into `@modelscript/runtime`'s `DAEBuilder` SoA linear memory arena.
- Projects EPANET networks into standard `Modelica.Fluid` pipes, reservoirs, and centrifugal pumps for joint thermo-fluid studies.

---

## Static Analysis & Pre-Flight Linter Rules

### Diagnostics for EPANET (8 rules)
| Code | Severity | Identifier | Summary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `M8101` | error | `isolated-hydraulic-node` | Hydraulic node '<nodeId>' is isolated with no connecting pipes or pumps. |
| `M8102` | warning | `negative-pressure-risk` | Junction '<nodeId>' elevation (<value>m) exceeds maximum network source head (<value>m), risking cavitation and dry-out. |
| `M8103` | error | `non-monotonic-pump-curve` | Pump head curve '<curveId>' violates decreasing monotonicity: head increases from <value> to <value> between flow <value> and <value>. |
| `M8104` | error | `zero-length-pipe` | Pipe link '<pipeId>' has non-positive physical length (<value>m). |
| `M8105` | error | `zero-diameter-pipe` | Pipe link '<pipeId>' has non-positive internal diameter (<value>mm). |
| `M8106` | error | `duplicate-node-id` | Duplicate node identifier '<nodeId>' detected in water network topology. |
| `M8107` | error | `duplicate-link-id` | Duplicate link identifier '<linkId>' detected in water network topology. |
| `M8108` | error | `unreferenced-node-in-link` | Link '<linkId>' references undefined endpoint node '<nodeId>'. |

---

## CLI Usage

```bash
# Inspect and lint an EPANET municipal water network
msx epanet inspect MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet lint MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp

# Solve steady-state network hydraulics (Todini GGM), EPS, PDD, and MOC water hammer
msx epanet solve MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet eps MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet pdd MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet surge MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp

# Run AWWA M36 IWA water audit, optimal pump scheduling, water quality, and topological diff
msx epanet audit MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet ops MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet quality MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp
msx epanet diff Baseline.inp Proposed.inp

# Ingest GeoJSON GIS pipe and node layers into an EPANET .inp deck
msx epanet from-gis pipes.geojson --nodes=junctions.geojson --out=MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp

# Lower network dynamics into ModelScript linear DAE arena or Modelica.Fluid
msx epanet to-dae MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp --out=network.dae.json
msx epanet to-modelica MunicipalWaterNetwork.inp -o MunicipalPipes.mo
```
